subject: Secure SDLC evidence: code review, CI/CD controls & secret handback workflow
messages:
From: Claire Thompson <claire@certifyaudit.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Secure SDLC artifacts for SIG/SOC2 review

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for agreeing to help with the SIG / SOC2 evidence collection. We are performing a focused review of change management and secrets stewardship for Veridian Financial and need a concise bundle to validate controls. Can you provide the following artifacts by EOD Wednesday (2026-05-06)?

1) Code review enforcement evidence for the main repo (PR gating logs, sample PRs, reviewer assignments) — 6 months.
2) CI/CD control logs showing gated deploys, job provenance and who approved production merges.
3) Secrets management policy + proof of KMS rotations (last 12 months).
4) Change approval runbook and a recent example of a change ticket with approvals.
5) Any automation around secret handback/escrow (when contractors rotate out or when short-lived creds are revoked).

If a single bundle is easier, a link or ZIP is fine. Also note any known exceptions or temporary bypasses in the reporting window. If you need more time, flag it and provide timelines.

Best,
Claire
Claire Thompson
Principal Assessor
CertifyAudit

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Secure SDLC artifacts for SIG/SOC2 review

Folks — forwarding an auditor request for Veridian. Claire needs the five artifacts listed below by EOD Wed. Can each of you take the items that map to your teams and send me a compiled bundle (single ZIP or Drive folder) by EOD Tuesday so I can do a quick sanity check?

Jordan: CI/CD logs, gated deploy evidence, job provenance (item 2 + 4 approver mapping).
Marissa: Code review evidence (item 1) + sample PRs; also link to PR gating policy.
Jonas: can you confirm the KMS rotation logs and the SOC2-friendly export format (item 3)?

Notes / constraints: do not include any live secret values in the bundle. Reference artifacts only (logs, hashes, ticket IDs). If there are attachments that must be redacted, mark them and include a short justification.

I copied Claire on the forward so she has visibility; if we plan any exception notes, add them to a single README in the bundle.

Thanks — Lauren

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Claire Thompson <claire@certifyaudit.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Secure SDLC artifacts for SIG/SOC2 review

Lauren / team / Claire — attaching a curated set of CI artifacts. Highlights: 

- redwood-ci-history-2025-2026.tgz (contains CI job metadata, signed job IDs, and pipeline run JSONs with non-sensitive fields).
- pr-review-ownership-2025.csv (export of PR reviewer assignments and timestamps for merged PRs).

Quick answers inline to Claire:
1) PR gating: we enforce required reviewers + passing checks. See sample PRs in the ZIP under /examples/pr-merge-2026-03-18.json.
2) CI/CD provenance: every pipeline produces a job signature (sha256) and the deploy job records approver IDs; see pipeline-run-logs/ for matched deploy events.
3) KMS rotations: Jordan cannot attest to rotation policy — tagging Jonas for the rotation proof.
4) Change approval: we keep ticket IDs in the deploy metadata — included sample ticket INF-1423.
5) Secret handback: we use short-lived credentials with automated revocation on offboarding; see secret-handback-process.md for the operational steps and webhook examples.

Redactions: all secrets and private keys are removed. The archive contains checksums and non-secret metadata only.

Attaching: redwood-ci-history-2025-2026.tgz; pr-review-ownership-2025.csv; secret-handback-process.md

— Jordan
Senior Platform Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: redwood-ci-history-2025-2026.tgz (tar.gz, 12MB, contains pipeline JSONs); pr-review-ownership-2025.csv (CSV, 34KB); secret-handback-process.md (Markdown, 3KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Claire Thompson <claire@certifyaudit.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Secure SDLC artifacts for SIG/SOC2 review

Adding the code-review and change governance artifacts. Summary: 

- runbook-change-governance-v2.pdf — our change approval runbook (v2 published Apr 2026). Sections included: emergency change path, canary rollback, approver matrix, and audit hooks.
- sample PRs folder: two merged PRs with reviewer diffs (redacted).
- change-ticket example: INF-1423 (reference included in runbook and pipeline logs).

Notes on PR gating: we require two independent reviewers for changes to core inference runtime. The CODEOWNERS file enforces reviewer suggestions and a CI job blocks merges without required labels. The runbook has the approval matrix and the allowed emergency bypass (requires two-level manual signoff and a postmortem within 48 hours).

Secrets handback: Jordan's secret-handback-process.md covers the mechanics; I added a short appendix (attached) describing where HR triggers offboarding and the webhook that revokes short-lived tokens. If auditors need the webhook delivery logs, we can provide redacted webhook traces for the last 12 months.

Attaching: runbook-change-governance-v2.pdf; appendix-secret-handback.pdf

— Marissa
Engineering Manager, Release Engineering
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: runbook-change-governance-v2.pdf (PDF, 420KB); appendix-secret-handback.pdf (PDF, 28KB)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@certifyaudit.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Secure SDLC artifacts for SIG/SOC2 review

Hi Claire — thank you for the clear list and timeline. We compiled the requested artifacts and redaction notes below. Everything is non-sensitive metadata only; no secrets or private keys are included. The package is attached and also shared via Drive for convenience.

Bundle contents (attached and Drive):
- redwood-ci-history-2025-2026.tgz — CI job metadata, deploy signatures, sample pipeline runs.
- pr-review-ownership-2025.csv — reviewer assignments and timestamps for merged PRs.
- runbook-change-governance-v2.pdf — published change approval runbook (April 2026).
- secret-handback-process.md + appendix-secret-handback.pdf — operational steps and example webhook traces (redacted).

Known exceptions / notes:
- Emergency bypasses in 2025: two incidents used the emergency path; both have postmortems attached (redacted PII).
- KMS rotation: Jonas confirmed rotations happen quarterly; Jonas, please consider this thread the auditor artifact confirmation.

Next steps: Claire, please confirm receipt and whether you need the redacted webhook traces or additional ticket-level exports. We can produce limited webhook traces (timestamps + event types) by EOD Friday if requested.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Compliance Programs (interim)
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood-ci-history-2025-2026.tgz; pr-review-ownership-2025.csv; runbook-change-governance-v2.pdf; secret-handback-process.md; appendix-secret-handback.pdf]
